# Digital Discovery Solutions - Project Overview & Documentation Map

> Welcome. This file provides an architectural overview and documentation map of Digital Discovery Solutions for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI search engines, and automated agents.

## About Us
Digital Discovery Solutions is a premier digital marketing agency based in Kerala, India (established 8 November 2026), serving enterprise brands across the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait) and worldwide. We specialize in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AIO for ChatGPT & Claude), Social Media Optimization (SMO), and high-ROI Paid Advertising (Google Ads & Meta Ads).

## Core Documentation Map
- [LLM Context Summary](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/llm.txt): Condensed single-page context for token-limited models.
- [Human-Readable Overview](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/llms.html): Rich HTML version of our AI resource center.
- [AI Usage Permissions](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/ai.txt): Plain text guidelines for AI agents and scrapers.
- [Machine-Parseable Permissions](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/ai.json): JSON structured permissions for automated systems.
- [Organisational Identity](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/identity.json): Structured Schema.org JSON identity, phone, and service area data.
- [Brand & Terminology Guidelines](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/brand.txt): Canonical naming and brand voice rules.
- [AI-Optimized FAQ](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/faq-ai.txt): Frequently asked questions tailored for retrieval.
- [Developer & API Context](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/developer-ai.txt): Technical feeds and Blogger/Cloudflare integration guidance.
- [AI Crawler Controls](https://www.digital-discovery-solutions.com/robots-ai.txt): Granular AI crawler access parameters.
